name: James Felton
source:
James, Baron of Felton, House Laor. The Baron is highly thought of and was touted as a possible suitor for [url=https://vndb.org/c165582]Charlie[/url]. The death of Felton's older brother saw the Barony pass to James as well as his brother's wife, [url=https://vndb.org/c165852]Imogen[/url]. The marriage has been troubled.
